## Confirmed hosted failure and immutable source

The [scheduled gated-sync run 40658701272](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-csv/actions/runs/40658701272/job/122716006773) at `a5ae949c0911a083cdb77e43a3385fc63bff6a87` fails during `pm github import unbraind/pm-csv --state all --atomic --gate --dry-run --with-comments`. The installed-package receipt identifies pm-github 2026.10.19 (the requested input still says 2026.10.16).

The log reports: `GitHub issue #197 has multiple existing owners; import plan is not idempotent. No item was written for this issue.` The refusal occurs before the actual import and repeat-import comparison. This is correct fail-closed behavior, not evidence of data loss or an importer runtime regression.

Two current canonical records both carry the identity tag `gh:unbraind/pm-csv#197`:

- [Imported issue pm-csv-github-2b408bfa2d7f-197](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-csv/blob/a5ae949c0911a083cdb77e43a3385fc63bff6a87/.agents/pm/issues/pm-csv-github-2b408bfa2d7f-197.toon), open, also records github_number 197 and the corresponding source URL.
- [Delivery chore pm-csv-2ms0](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-csv/blob/a5ae949c0911a083cdb77e43a3385fc63bff6a87/.agents/pm/chores/pm-csv-2ms0.toon), in_progress, retains implementation notes and four test-provenance records. [PR #200](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-csv/pull/200) links this chore and fixes [issue #197](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-csv/issues/197).

## Expected behavior and impact

The GitHub import identity should resolve deterministically to one canonical import owner while delivery/source relationships remain expressible without acquiring a second unique import identity. The current ambiguity blocks scheduled tracker refresh. Preserve both records' knowledge, provenance, relationships, and append-only history; do not delete a legitimate record or relax the ambiguity/privacy/no-op guards to make CI green.

This is a project-corpus repair, distinct from pm-github #175 / PR #190's repeat-import timestamp churn. All 209 pm-csv issue/PR records across all statuses, issue #197/PR #200 conversations, current canonical records, and pm-github175/PR190 were checked; no existing identity-repair finding was located. The job is still the latest observed run on the current default HEAD.

## Acceptance and regression checks

- Choose and document one import owner for GitHub #197 using supported PM operations; represent the other item's delivery relationship without an ambiguous import-identity tag.
- Preserve both item IDs and existing history, notes, provenance and meaningful source/delivery links; record any intentional lineage reconciliation.
- In an isolated recoverable copy, first reproduce the current refusal, then verify dry-run planning is unambiguous after the repair.
- Verify actual isolated import and identical repeat import preserve item/history bytes appropriately; retain the publication no-diff and privacy gates.
- Prove a deliberately duplicated import identity still refuses before writes. Do not treat an unrelated green build or source merge as deployed/published repair.

Limits: hosted failure plus immutable static corpus evidence; no independent local import/replay was performed, no provider data was mutated, and no published runtime defect is claimed.
